product_metadata.title: Nestl Coral Pink Full Bed Skirt - Full Size Bed Skirt 14 Inch Drop - Brushed Microfiber Bed Skirts - Hotel Quality Pleated Bed Skirt - Shrinkage & Fade Resistant
features: BED SKIRT FULL SIZE: Full size Bed Skirt measures 54” x 75” inches (137 x 190 cm) with a 14” long tailored drop for a crisp, finished look.
PREMIUM HIGH-QUALITY MATERIAL: Woven from high-quality double-brushed 100GSM microfiber material, resulting in a strong, durable, long-lasting material.
STAYS IN PLACE: Our bed skirts are heavy enough to stay in place, yet light enough to allow natural movement so they never look or feel stiff!

ELEGANT AND VIBRANT: Place the Nestl Bed Skirt between your mattress and box spring for a beautiful and elegant way to update your bedroom décor, hides your bed legs and frame along with under bed storage.
EASY CARE & CLEANING: Machine washable in cold water and tumble dry on low. Fade, stain, shrink and wrinkle resistant, easy to iron.
